scientific_integrity: Analytic partition-Mobius reduction plus exact integer-polynomial identity checks; finite permutation enumeration independently cross-checks sizes seven and nine. No claim of independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Theorem covers uniform rank permutations of odd size at least seven and individual positive-frequency Fourier energies; not mixed-mode moments, full null distributions, power, estimated parameters or even sample sizes.
title: Third-moment torsion resonance in Fourier energies of uniform rank permutations
